The numbers reproduce exactly: I re-ran scratchpad r13rc/k2bed_agg.py in 7.8 s, with parity 71/71, ins35 0.92632, lp30 +0.00051, fm45 +0.00035, dc0.30 +0.00336 and dc+lp +0.00387. What fails is the 'REVIVED' reading and its value claims.
(1) The dc0.30 bed is in-sample for DeepCenter. By FACTS F-DAT-12, DeepCenter was trained ONLY on the 71 44b6 clips, which are exactly the clips of this bed. So '0 TP lost, gain all division term' is the model scoring its own training data. That hides the one private-risk channel: true divisions that score lower out of sample and get cut by the higher threshold. r13dp-3 shows that '0 TP lost' in small lab draws is Poisson-likely even when a threshold band holds real divisions. The claim that 'the embryo-negative T9 reason does not reproduce' compares two in-sample 44b6 reads (exp60 -0.0006 vs exp64 +0.0034). The honest bed for dc0.30 is still only 6bba (exp60 +0.0010).
(2) The support is tiny. dc0.30 = 9 FP forks, one per clip; 3 of the 9 sit in clips with 0 GT divisions. The 71 crops come from one embryo, and leak groups were ignored, so the CI is too narrow. On the 17 exp60 clips the effect is +0.00004. The insertion base itself (+0.00458) rests on 2 clips (W/L 0/2, div TP +2), also in-sample for DaughterNet.
(3) The 'no ladder knob is negative' line overstates. The lp30 CI crosses 0 ([-0.00043, +0.00142], 5 losing clips, TP -4 from the lowrefine interaction). fm45 is 1 fork in 1 clip (W/L 1/0).
(4) 'Additive' tests nothing. The sums are exact to 5 dp (0.00051+0.00035 = 0.00086, 0.00336+0.00051 = 0.00387) because the edits touch disjoint nodes, forks and clips on this bed. That says nothing about interaction on unseen embryos.
(5) Decision value is ~0 by the finding's own action. L9 and L5 do not change and public reads decide. By the ~1/6 lab->LB rule, +0.0034 lab is ~+0.0006 public, below display resolution, so it cannot even serve as a sharp pre-registered calibration check.
(6) The real risk is misuse. Round-13 agents already turn it into 'dc0.30 is the lab-best division knob for informed combos' (division_pp) and use it to size the R13-RC-C veto as low-value. That is the in-sample over-trust pattern of the edge-filter lesson (+0.016 local, 0 on LB).
FEASIBILITY is fine: zero cost, no build, no slot, no rule conflict as a CONTEXT info line. But it must not be recorded as 'revived' or as positive evidence.
fix: If recorded at all, write ONE CONTEXT info line labelled 'IN-SAMPLE, calibration only, no combo or finals weight'. Suggested line: 'exp64 44b6 K2 bed (DeepCenter was trained on these 71 clips, DaughterNet in-sample): vs ins35, lp30 +0.0005 (CI crosses 0; lowrefine costs TP -4), fm45 +0.0004 (1 fork), dc0.30 +0.0034 (9 FP forks, 1 per clip; on the 17 exp60 clips +0.00004). Sums are exact because the edits have disjoint supports; this does not test interaction. The honest dc bed is 6bba only.' Drop 'no ladder knob is negative', 'the T9 reason does not reproduce' and 'additive'. Do not cite it in the L5 combo choice, as a 'lab-best' tiebreak, or to down-weight the R13-RC-C 6bba veto: if anything, the in-sample status of this bed is a reason to keep that veto, since the veto bed is honest. Curator: I-202/I-231 stay refuted on VOI, with an informational note 'measured at zero GPU on exp64, 44b6 in-sample, see above'.
realistic_gain: ~0 on private/public: no decision changes by construction (L9/L5 unchanged; lab +0.0034 -> ~+0.0006 public at 1/6, below display). Slightly negative expected value if its 'no knob negative / additive / lab-best' framing steers combos or weakens the dc0.30 6bba veto. Cost ~0 (CPU already spent).
